$comment: Curation manifest for the lib's EXPORTED components. Keyed by catalog id (the kebab-cased story title). Each entry enriches the generated catalog item with an import statement + props (read from the colocated *.props.json the story also renders), usage guidance, key brand tokens, and end-to-end examples whose full source is embedded verbatim (with the examples/_lib shim rewritten to the package name). Paths are relative to packages/ds-patternfly.

ai-chat.usage: AiAssistant is the lib's exported AI chat experience: a brandable prompt bar that renders inline wherever you place it, plus the surfaces it grows into — a transient recent-chat popover and a repositionable, resizable, searchable full-conversation panel (a modal below the sm breakpoint). Overlays portal into the `overlayContainer` element (position: relative) and anchor to its corners. Wire your backend via `onSend`; seed restored history via `initialMessages`; localise every string via `labels`. Styles ship in the lib stylesheet (`@golden-passport/ds-patternfly/styles`) — no extra CSS import.

examples.description: The assistant docked in the app Shell: branded masthead + sidebar nav, content stage as the overlay container, and a live async onSend handler.

recipes-pageheader.usage: PageHeader is the standard top-of-page header recipe: a title row (optional icon + status <Label> + right-aligned actions), an optional subtitle, a breadcrumb slot above, and a tabs strip below. Every region is a ReactNode slot — fill what you need. Built from branded react-core primitives; no labels prop (all text is caller-provided content).

recipes-filtertoolbar.usage: FilterToolbar is the fully-controlled filter bar recipe: a search field, faceted multi-select facets (FilterDef[]), removable filter chips, and one-click clear-all. You own searchValue + values and update them from onSearchChange / onChange / onClearAll; chips and clear-all derive from values automatically. Localise chrome text via labels (filterToolbarEnLabels).

recipes-bulkselecttoolbar.usage: BulkSelectToolbar is the controlled 'select many, act on many' recipe: a split checkbox + dropdown (select all / page / none), a derived '{n} selected' status, and bulk actions shown once a selection exists. You own the selection; pass counts + handlers. The split checkbox reflects page-selected / partially-selected state. Localise via labels (bulkSelectToolbarEnLabels).

recipes-listmanager.usage: ListManager is the layout-only page scaffold for a managed collection: header slot (PageHeader), a toolbar row (FilterToolbar + BulkSelectToolbar left via `toolbar`, Pagination right via `toolbarEnd`), the list body (children — a Table or Gallery), and a footer pagination slot. It owns the vertical rhythm and toolbar arrangement; you bring the pieces and the data.

patterns-dashboardshell.usage: DashboardShell is the dashboard page scaffold: a titled header band (title + description + right-aligned actions slot) over a content region you fill with a KPI strip, charts, and status cards (children). Layout + rhythm only — chart libraries (@patternfly/react-charts, ECharts) stay in your app and never enter the design system.
